name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin
description: Bindex Maven Plugin is a Java 17 Maven plugin that brings Machai Ghostwriter Bindex workflows into Maven builds. It provides four thread-safe goals: the reactor-wide bindex goal generates Bindex metadata once for a build, bindex-per-module generates metadata separately in each Maven module, register registers reactor metadata, and register-per-module registers metadata for each module. Generation invokes the bindex Machai Act and registration invokes bindex/register. Goals receive Maven session, project, effective settings, and base-directory context and support workflow configuration files, model selection, supplemental instructions, excluded paths, a selected settings.xml server, and arbitrary action parameters. The plugin is suited to command-line usage and lifecycle-bound metadata generation and registry registration in single- and multi-module Maven projects. Model-assisted workflows can use providers configured through Machai Ghostwriter and its GenAI client; credentials should be held outside project POM files.

domains: Maven plugin development and lifecycle integration
usageContext: Generating Bindex metadata for Java artifacts
Registering generated metadata with the Bindex registry
Ghostwriter workflows requiring Maven project and settings context

constructors.description: Maven-instantiated aggregator mojo for the reactor-wide Bindex generation goal. Maven creates the mojo reflectively and injects settings, session, project context when available, base directory, and workflow parameters before execution.

examples.description: Use Maven's plugin goal rather than constructing the Mojo directly in application code; this command runs the reactor-wide generation workflow.

constructors.description: Maven-instantiated non-aggregator mojo for generating Bindex metadata in the current Maven project. Each module to which the goal is bound receives its own execution and project context.

examples.description: Invoke generation in module execution contexts when each Maven module needs an independent Bindex document.

constructors.description: Maven-instantiated aggregator mojo for registration of generated Bindex metadata across the reactor. It inherits the shared workflow configuration and delegates registration to the bindex/register Machai Act.

examples.description: Run the reactor-level registration workflow after the corresponding metadata has been generated.

constructors.description: Maven-instantiated non-aggregator mojo for registering metadata within the current module's Maven context. It inherits per-module workflow configuration and delegates to bindex/register.

examples.description: Run registration separately in the module contexts that contain generated module-specific Bindex metadata.

features.name: bindex
features.description: Executes the bindex Machai Act once for the reactor. This thread-safe aggregator goal does not require a Maven project and accepts workflow context and configuration inherited from the Ghostwriter Maven integration.

examples.description: Generate reactor-level Bindex metadata and explicitly select a provider model. Configure credentials in the chosen Maven settings server and select it with genai.serverId when the workflow requires authentication.

features.name: bindex-per-module
features.description: Executes the bindex Machai Act for the current Maven project. This thread-safe goal requires a project, is not an aggregator, and can be bound to a lifecycle phase to generate metadata independently for participating modules.

examples.description: Run module-scoped generation with optional additional instructions. The goal executes within each bound module's project context.

features.name: register
features.description: Executes bindex/register once for the reactor to register previously generated metadata. This thread-safe aggregator goal can be invoked without a Maven project and inherits shared workflow configuration from org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo.

examples.description: Invoke a single registration workflow for metadata produced for the complete Maven reactor. Supply registry and workflow settings through the configured Ghostwriter workflow.

features.name: register-per-module
features.description: Executes bindex/register for the current Maven module, requiring a project and executing separately in module context. It inherits the workflow parameters and Maven context provided by org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexPerModuleMojo.

examples.description: Register module-specific metadata separately for every participating project in a multi-module build.

customizations.name: Ghostwriter workflow configuration
customizations.description: Each goal inherits configuration for an optional workflow configuration file, model selection, supplemental instructions, excluded paths, a selected Maven settings server, and arbitrary action-specific string parameters. The effective Maven settings and session are made available to the workflow. Provider-specific configuration is handled by the transitive Machai GenAI client; credentials should not be committed in the POM.
customizations.type: Maven plugin parameters and workflow properties

examples.description: Select a model and Maven settings server and exclude generated build files for a reactor generation run. Additional configuration can be supplied using gw.config or the plugin params map.

customizations.name: Lifecycle-bound per-module goals
customizations.description: The per-module generation and registration goals can be attached to a Maven lifecycle phase through standard plugin executions. This allows module-specific Bindex processing to run consistently as part of a project build.

examples.description: Add this plugin execution to a parent POM to run module-scoped metadata generation during verify for applicable modules.

examples.title: Install and run reactor-wide Bindex generation
examples.description: Install the plugin through Maven plugin coordinates in the consuming project's POM, configure workflow access outside the project source, then invoke the aggregator goal from the reactor root.
steps: Add org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.3 in the build/plugins section of the consuming project's POM; Maven resolves the released plugin from its configured repositories.
If the selected provider requires credentials, add a server with id machai-genai to the user's Maven settings.xml. Keep API keys and passwords out of the POM and source control.
Choose a model using the gw.model Maven property and select the settings entry using genai.serverId when needed.
From the reactor root, run mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.3:bindex.
The aggregator invokes the bindex Machai Act once with the Maven workflow context to generate metadata for the reactor.

examples.title: Generate and register metadata for every module
examples.description: Configure generation and registration as module-scoped Maven goals when each module needs its own Bindex document and registry operation.
steps: Declare org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.3 in the parent POM build/plugins configuration so all intended modules inherit it.
Bind bindex-per-module to verify to generate module-specific metadata as part of the lifecycle.
Run mvn verify from the reactor root; Maven executes generation in each participating module context.
After successful generation, run register-per-module from the reactor root to register each module's metadata through the bindex/register Act.
Supply optional workflow properties such as gw.config, gw.model, gw.instructions, gw.excludes, genai.serverId, or action-specific params as appropriate.

examples.title: Configure a direct OpenAI workflow credential in Maven settings
examples.description: Provider-specific properties are passed to the underlying workflow. Store the API key in the selected Maven server configuration rather than committing it to the POM.
steps: Create a user-level Maven settings.xml server entry with an id such as machai-openai.
Provide the provider's OPENAI_API_KEY in the selected server configuration as supported by the Ghostwriter GenAI integration.
Select the server and OpenAI model on the Maven invocation.
Run the desired generation or registration goal with that configuration.
